findings.F1: The tested effect sits on the predicted side but just short of the bar. Its next-day short unusual move is +0.26 % with a day-clustered t of 1.88 over 6519 cases on 1426 days. On the folds shown (B, C) it is +0.46 % with t 2.05 over 2148 cases on 601 days.
findings.F2: The effect is carried by the depth of the 5-day loss and is absent elsewhere. By quintile of the 5-day return including the up day, the move is:
findings.F3: The strongest forecasts carry the result. The top fifth of |forecast| gives +1.61 % with t 2.95 (430 cases on 186 days). The other four fifths range from −0.15 % to +0.48 %, none with t above 1.36, and the correlation between forecast and the unusual move is −0.11.
findings.F4: Width helps less clearly than depth.
findings.F5: The effect is spent in one day, as the brief says. The unusual move is +0.46 % (t 2.05) over 1 day, +0.30 % (t 0.95) over 2 days and +0.24 % (t 0.68) over 3 days. It is also specific to up days: on falling-market down days the same short loses −0.32 % (t −1.38).
findings.F6: Where the agitation can be read (about 730 cases), the fade lives in agitated markets. Agitated: +1.00 %, t 1.97, 361 cases on 110 days. Calm: −0.52 %, t −1.07, 369 cases.
findings.F7: The effect is broad but not uniform across coins and periods.
findings.F8: Over all cases the size is too small to trade. The total move per case is +0.17 %, below the 0.22 % cost of a trade. The deepest-loss fifth (+1.98 %) and the strongest-forecast fifth (+1.61 %) are each several times that cost.

ideas.idea: In a falling market, an up day is followed by a fall over the next day, larger the wider its high-to-low range against the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days and the more the coin is still down over its 5-day return including that day, only while the coin is still down over its 5-day return including that day.
ideas.consequence: In a downtrend, a trader shorts for one day only those up days that leave the coin below its level of 5 days ago, sized up by how deep that loss is and how wide the day was, and leaves bounces that have already recovered the week alone.
ideas.name: still-down bounce fades next day

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, an up day is followed by a fall over the next day, larger the wider its high-to-low range against the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days and the more the coin is still down over its 5-day return including that day.
ideas.consequence: A trader fades the up days of a downtrend for one day only while the coin is swinging more than usual for it, sized by the day's width and the depth of its 5-day loss.
ideas.name: agitated downtrend bounce fade
